cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: She is the sole person visible and speaking throughout the video. Her name is also in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Harvard University

on_screen_text.text: Kentanji Brown Jackson's advice to young people

spoken_summary: Ketanji Brown Jackson offers advice to young people, stating they can "do and be anything." She tearfully recounts a story from her freshman year at Harvard, where as a public school student from Miami, she felt out of place and questioned if she belonged. She recalls an anonymous Black woman walking past her one evening, who sensed her struggle and told her to "persevere."
audio_music: The video consists solely of Ketanji Brown Jackson's spoken voice, with no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static, uncut shot of a person speaking, in a talking-head style.
central_claim: Through a personal story of overcoming self-doubt at Harvard with the encouragement of a stranger, Ketanji Brown Jackson advises young people to persevere through challenges.
intended_effect: To inspire viewers with Jackson's story of resilience and present her as an empathetic and motivational public figure.
